source: hand-written synthetic cases, no real people

cases.answer: I've been feeling a bit tired since yesterday, but otherwise alright.

Well now... my grandson Tobias Wendemuth came by on Sunday... he's studying to be an engineer, you know, very clever boy... we watched the football together... oh, and I've got a rash on my arms... and my nails are cracked... the team lost again, of course.
Well... it comes and goes... I suppose.
Well... let me see now... it started... three days ago, I believe.
I had some of them, I think, the white ones. Not sure about the others.
Is the post here yet? I'm waiting for a letter from my brother Edmund Ravelstock.
My neighbour Gertrude Pollinger has a new cat... a grey one... with white paws.
Sorry, what was that? I didn't catch it.

Oh... it's a long story... my late wife Hildegard always said I made a fuss about nothing... she used to grow tomatoes in the back garden, the best in the street... anyway... the rash is quite bad, it keeps me up at night... and the tomatoes this year were terrible, all split.
expected_not_relevant: the tomatoes this year were terrible

cases.answer: Well... I was at my sister Margarethe's for her birthday party... there was a lovely cake, chocolate with cherries... and the nails, I think they started cracking two days ago... she's turning eighty-eight, can you believe it.

The pharmacy delivery man was late again... he always comes on his bicycle, rain or shine... my dog barked at him the whole time... but yes, I took my medicine after breakfast... he's a nice young man really.
expected_relevant: I took my medicine after breakfast

cases.answer: So this week was hectic, my daughter moved house and we spent two days packing boxes and driving back and forth, and the traffic was awful, honestly the worst I've seen, but to answer you, I started a new hand cream on Monday, a lavender one, and otherwise the same food as always, and then on Wednesday the removal van broke down.
Yes. I couldn't do up my buttons this morning.
Something on my skin, maybe. I'm not sure what it is.
Not today. Before that, I think.
The television's been broken... since Thursday, you know... nothing on but static.
